stemMd: Which area has the highest delivered share of orders?

options.label: B
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Village: 40/50=80%; Town: 70/100=70%; Harbour: 135/150=90%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 90%.

distractorRationale.d: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 80%, 70%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.a: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 80%, 70%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.b: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
